# Garden Route Eat API - 200 Real Places
> Verified GPS + Google Maps + Waze + Apple Maps for Garden Route restaurants.

Endpoints:
- /api/eat/knysna.json - 35 places inc 34 South
- /api/eat/plettenberg-bay.json
- /api/eat/george.json
- /api/eat/mossel-bay.json
- /api/eat/wilderness.json
- /api/eat/sedgefield.json
